title: Calm, photo-forward client page — three directions

s1.description: What the design team asked for, and why the page reads busy today.

s2.description: Direction A, Gallery: one photograph per screen, the asks in one quiet line.

s3.description: Direction B, Lookbook: a pinned photograph beside quiet words, the asks in one card.

s4.description: Direction C, Album: the house as a contact sheet, papers on their own page.

s5.description: How the three compare, what we recommend, and what the founders rule on.
